title: My quests.
intro: Custom Parallel Quests I’ve scripted and released, newest first. Every one is a free download for PC: install the .x2m file with the XV2 Mods Installer (needs the XV2 Patcher).

items.title: Goku Day Pack: Goku’s Blazing Spirit Duo Duel
items.summary: You and a friend take on Goku in a 2v1 Parallel Quest. Adds 9 new skills and a colourable Turtle Gi costume.
items.requirements: No paid DLC needed. Game updated to at least the DLC 7 patch.

items.title: The Heroes Marvellous Show
items.summary: Help Hercule save the world from Beebus. Adds Hercule (World Saviour) and Beebus as playable characters, 3 skills and a Beebus costume.

items.title: itsErichDUH’s Corruption Crisis!
items.summary: YouTuber itsEricDUH has been corrupted by dark forces, and you have to save him in a 1v1 showdown. Adds 2 playable characters, a Kame House stage, 2 attacks and a jacket costume.

items.title: Banana Blitz Showdown
items.summary: Save Simply Platano from Evil Complex Banana in a 1v1 showdown. Adds 3 playable characters, a new attack and a colourable costume for all races.
items.requirements: No paid DLC needed. Game updated to at least the DLC 14 patch.

items.title: The Nameless Namekian
items.summary: Piccolo has received a gift from Shenron and challenges you to a 1v1 against all his forms.
items.requirements: No paid DLC needed. Game updated to at least the DLC 16 patch (1.36).
items.credit: Giant Orange Piccolo model by AleWarrior89, used with permission

items.title: Vegeta’s Humiliation?!
items.summary: My remake of the Raging Blast what-if: Vegeta can’t go Super Saiyan, so he takes it out on Super Saiyan Trunks, Gohan and Goku.
items.requirements: No paid DLC needed. Game updated to at least the DLC 1 patch (1.05).

items.title: Yamcha’s Resolve!?
items.summary: My remake of the Raging Blast what-if: Yamcha thinks Vegeta is stealing Bulma and challenges him, then Trunks, to a fight.

items.title: The World Tournament: Couple’s Division
items.summary: My remake of the Raging Blast what-if: Krillin and Android 18 face Gohan and Videl in the first World Couples Championship.
items.requirements: No paid DLC needed. Game updated to at least the DLC 1 patch (1.05).

download_note: Free downloads, no account or membership needed. Commissions are a separate service, below.
